reference_sql:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per session of a visitor who signed up
  SELECT s.visitor_id, s.utm_source,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.visitor_id ORDER BY s.session_start, s.session_id) AS rn
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN signups u ON u.visitor_id = s.visitor_id
)
SELECT utm_source, COUNT(*) AS visitors
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY utm_source
alternatives:
WITH firsts AS (  -- one row per visitor who signed up
  SELECT s.visitor_id, MIN(s.session_start) AS first_start
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN signups u ON u.visitor_id = s.visitor_id
  GROUP BY s.visitor_id
),
first_ids AS (  -- one row per visitor who signed up
  SELECT s.visitor_id, MIN(s.session_id) AS session_id
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN firsts f ON f.visitor_id = s.visitor_id AND f.first_start = s.session_start
  GROUP BY s.visitor_id
)
SELECT s.utm_source, COUNT(*) AS visitors
FROM first_ids fi
JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id = fi.session_id
GROUP BY s.utm_source

SELECT t.utm_source, COUNT(*) AS visitors
FROM (
  -- one row per session of a visitor who signed up, numbered from the first
  SELECT s.visitor_id, s.utm_source,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.visitor_id ORDER BY s.session_start, s.session_id) AS rn
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN signups u ON u.visitor_id = s.visitor_id
) AS t
WHERE t.rn = 1
GROUP BY t.utm_source

),

  SELECT s.visitor_id, MIN(s.session_id) AS session_id
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN firsts f ON f.visitor_id = s.visitor_id AND f.first_start = s.session_start

)
SELECT s.utm_source, COUNT(*) AS visitors
FROM first_ids fi
JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id = fi.session_id
GROUP BY s.utm_source
other_way.tradeoff: Taking the earliest start, then the lowest session_id at that start, needs no window but takes two grouping steps.

solver.query:
SELECT utm_source, COUNT(*) AS visitors
FROM (
  SELECT s.visitor_id, s.utm_source,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.visitor_id ORDER BY s.session_start ASC, s.session_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM sessions s
  WHERE s.visitor_id IN (SELECT visitor_id FROM signups)
) t
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY utm_source
